annotation.title_clean: 国家发展改革委 国务院妇儿工委办公室关于在全社会推进儿童友好建设的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions of the National Development and Reform Commission and the Office of the State Council Working Committee on Women and Children on Promoting Child-Friendly Development Across Society
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家发展改革委; 国务院妇儿工委办公室
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national opinions (Feb 2026) on promoting child-friendly development nationwide, covering child-perspective policymaking, public facilities, priority public services, child protection including online protection, publicity and funding support. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Cities as basic units to systematically integrate child-friendly policies
Introduce a child's-eye 1-metre perspective in spatial planning and explore child impact assessment
Free or preferential public services, including HPV vaccination for girls aged 13
Strengthen minors' online protection and age verification via digital credentials
No demonstration creation, acceptance or title awarding; provincial governments monitor and self-assess annually
